ideas.idea: Add the missing /img/loaves.jpg image or fix the path
ideas.why: index.html references /img/loaves.jpg and no img folder exists in the repo, so the image would 404.

ideas.idea: Add Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD to the home page
ideas.why: The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Show address, opening hours and contact as text on the home page or a visit section
ideas.why: No page has this information, and it is basic local-business content that readers and machines need.

ideas.idea: List every loaf on breads.html with ingredients and baking days, possibly with their own pages
ideas.why: The page claims over twenty loaves but names only two, so adding the list gives readers and machines real content.

ideas.idea: Add price, date, duration and a booking link to classes.html
ideas.why: The page tells people to book early but gives no way to book and no practical details.

ideas.idea: Explain how pre-ordering works on the home page or a new page
ideas.why: The home page mentions weekend pre-ordering but gives no instructions or link.
This is valid but has little effect on a three-URL sitemap, and the report itself says to add dates only if they are real.

ideas.idea: Add og:title, og:description and og:image tags to each page
ideas.why: This is standard share-preview advice that applies to almost any site and does little for discovery or understanding.

ideas.idea: Add onward links between breads and classes pages
ideas.why: The site-wide nav on every page already links to all pages, so extra links add little.
